mapper.select: SELECT id AS alertId, payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId FROM payment_alert_log WHERE alert_type = 'STOCK_CONFIRMATION_FAILED' AND id > #{lastId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE))) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{chunkSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='PROCESSING', updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id = #{alertId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE)))
mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock s JOIN order_item oi ON oi.product_id = s.product_id SET s.reserved_quantity = s.reserved_quantity - oi.quantity, s.sold_quantity = s.sold_quantity + oi.quantity, s.updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND s.reserved_quantity >= oi.quantity
UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='RESOLVED', resolved_at=NOW(6), updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='FAILED', retry_count=retry_count+1, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
